statement.excerpt: As of April 27 2026, only two buildings are operational and generating revenue, and the third barely has any IT gear in it. I estimate the total cost of Stargate Abilene to be around $52.8 billion.
statement.document_title: AI's Economics Don't Make Sense [Ad Free]

from_speaker: only two buildings are operational and generating revenue
the third barely has any IT gear in it
our_interpretation: Assess the complete compound claim, preserving its explicit April 27 date.
Operational and generating revenue requires customer service and billing, rather than an externally complete building or an energized shell.
Read barely any IT gear as only a small fraction of the third building's intended IT installation; no numerical cutoff was supplied.
Read total cost as the completed eight-building campus including IT equipment, rather than construction financing alone.
Assess whether the cost estimate has independent support, not merely whether Zitron published that estimate.
criteria.support_condition: Dated records establish exactly two revenue-generating buildings on April 27, very limited IT installation in the third, and a reasonably comparable all-in campus estimate near $52.8 billion.
criteria.contradiction_condition: Comparable records establish a different operating and billing count, substantial IT installation in the third building, or an all-in cost materially inconsistent with $52.8 billion.
